'If this hits a hero, they LOSE 1{h}.'

LOSE_LIFE, not damage. Losing life is not being dealt damage (CR 8.5.x): it cannot be prevented, does not trigger on-damage abilities, and is not reduced by Arcane Barrier or a prevention shield. Authoring it as DEAL_PHYSICAL would make the clause blockable and would fire every 'when you are dealt damage' trigger the opponent controls.
